headword: {即日|そくじつ}{発送|はっそう}

definitions.explanation: Shipping or dispatching an order on the same day it is placed. A selling point commonly advertised by online retailers and mail-order services.

examples.japanese: この{商品|しょうひん}は{即日|そくじつ}{発送|はっそう}{可能|かのう}です。
examples.english: This product is available for same-day shipping.

examples.japanese: {午前中|ごぜんちゅう}に{注文|ちゅうもん}すれば{即日|そくじつ}{発送|はっそう}いたします。
examples.english: If you order before noon, we will ship the same day.

examples.japanese: {即日|そくじつ}{発送|はっそう}の{対応|たいおう}は{平日|へいじつ}のみとなっておりますので、ご{了承|りょうしょう}ください。
examples.english: Please note that same-day shipping is available on weekdays only.

notes:
Composed of {即日|そくじつ} (the same day, immediately) and {発送|はっそう} (shipping, dispatch). This is a standard e-commerce and logistics term seen on product pages and in order confirmations. The prefix {即日|そくじつ} is productive and appears in many compounds: {即日|そくじつ}{完売|かんばい} (sold out same day), {即日|そくじつ}{対応|たいおう} (same-day response).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {即日|そくじつ}{発送|はっそう}{可能|かのう}: same-day shipping available
- {即日|そくじつ}{発送|はっそう}に{対応|たいおう}する: to offer same-day shipping
- {即日|そくじつ}{発送|はっそう}{対象|たいしょう}{商品|しょうひん}: products eligible for same-day shipping

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {翌日|よくじつ}{配達|はいたつ}: next-day delivery — delivery on the following day
- {当日|とうじつ}{配送|はいそう}: same-day delivery — focuses on the delivery arriving the same day, while {即日|そくじつ}{発送|はっそう} emphasizes the dispatch happening the same day
